The Subtask Name: Extract Pie Filling Ingredients From Audio File  
Agents_edges:  
- From_agent: AudioProcessing_Expert  
  To_agent: TranscriptionVerification_Expert  
  agent_dependency_type: obs_dependency  
  agent_strength: 0.95  
  agent_explanation: The AudioProcessing_Expert provides the raw audio transcription to the TranscriptionVerification_Expert for verification. This ensures that the transcription is accurate and free of errors.  
  agent_failure_modes:  
    - type: data_issue  
      description: The AudioProcessing_Expert might misinterpret background noise or unclear audio as part of the recipe instructions.  
      severity: 0.80  
      if_from_agent_wrong: If the AudioProcessing_Expert incorrectly transcribes an ingredient, the TranscriptionVerification_Expert may not catch it, leading to wrong ingredients being passed to the Culinary_Expert.  
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Culinary_Expert might receive an incorrect ingredient list, leading to failed pie-making.  

- From_agent: TranscriptionVerification_Expert  
  To_agent: Culinary_Expert  
  agent_dependency_type: reasoning_continuation  
  agent_strength: 0.90  
  agent_explanation: The TranscriptionVerification_Expert verifies the transcription and ensures it accurately reflects the recipe instructions. This verified transcription is then used by the Culinary_Expert to extract the ingredients.  
  agent_failure_modes:  
    - type: data_issue  
      description: The TranscriptionVerification_Expert might miss an ingredient or incorrectly verify a transcription, leading to incomplete or incorrect ingredient list.  
      severity: 0.75  
      if_from_agent_wrong: If the TranscriptionVerification_Expert incorrectly verifies a transcription, the Culinary_Expert will rely on wrong information, leading to incorrect ingredient list.  
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Culinary_Expert will produce an incorrect or incomplete list of ingredients, affecting the pie-making process.  

- From_agent: Culinary_Expert  
  To_agent: (no further agent)  
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency  
  agent_strength: 0.85  
  agent_explanation: The Culinary_Expert uses the verified transcription to list the ingredients for the pie filling. This list is then used by the user to shop for the required ingredients.  
  agent_failure_modes:  
    - type: data_issue  
      description: The Culinary_Expert might misinterpret the transcription or miss an ingredient, leading to incomplete or incorrect ingredient list.  
      severity: 0.70  
      if_from_agent_wrong: If the Culinary_Expert incorrectly lists an ingredient, the user will shop for the wrong items, leading to missing ingredients for the pie.  
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The user will have missing ingredients, affecting the ability to make the pie.
